name: Cinema Project
description: Every movie already has a soul: most of it buried in a poster and thumbnail. Cinema Project builds a virtual room experience around that instead. Walk through it like a video game: poster art lining the walls, a fanart and video slideshow across the backwall, theme songs filling the room, trailers, theme videos, or the movie itself playing on the screen up front. None of it is new, it's what your library already had, finally given space to be experienced all together, visualized all at once. On top of that, Ambient Mode lets you create your own feature show, similar to a pre-roll.
overview: Watch and listen to the soul of a movie, a visualized experience you step into like a video game.

versions.changelog: Renamed the configuration XML to Jellyfin.Plugin.CinemaProject.xml and moved the code namespace to Jellyfin.Plugin.CinemaProject. IMPORTANT when updating an existing install: stop Jellyfin, rename CinemaProjectLoader.xml in the plugin configurations folder to Jellyfin.Plugin.CinemaProject.xml, then start again, otherwise the plugin falls back to default settings.

Added server-side persisted settings for Kiosk, Controls, Display, Room, Posters (including Ambient Mode), and Backwall (110 fields), plus Misc's own two remaining fields. Moved the earlier standalone Smart Launch settings page into this same 7-tab structure. Added a Backup/restore via code feature to Misc. Every setting is now feature complete and server-side persisted.
